Agent Name: Verification_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Verification_Expert incorrectly concluded that none of the contributors to OpenCV version 4.1.2 matched the name of a former Chinese head of government. In the search results, there was no mention of "Li Peng" as a contributor, who indeed should have been identified as a matching name with a former Chinese Premier. Furthermore, there was misinterpretation, and the names listed from search results (such as Alexander Alekhin, Dmitry Kurtaev, etc.) weren't thoroughly checked against names of Chinese heads of government who might have minor errors or alternative transliterations in historical documentation leading to missing Li Peng. The agent's analysis was incomplete in this respect, leading to an inaccurate conclusion.
